meta.title: OncoLens Streaming Architecture (oncolens.mmai)
meta.description: How the oncolens Python package streams the DFCI MatchMiner-AI synthetic oncology corpus from Hugging Face one patient at a time: HTTP range reads of parquet columns (nothing stored on disk), forward-only grouping by pseudo_mrn, optional side tables for trial labels and dates, derived y labels, quality flags, and a leakage-free model_input. Scope: oncolens/ and its tests only.

nodes.label: CLI: python -m oncolens.mmai
nodes.description: main() (L446-488): argparse flags --split/--limit/--sample/--dates/--summary/--no-y/--model-input/--revision/-o. Rejects bad args via parser.error before any download, writes one JSON object per line (JSONL) to stdout or a file, closes the generator in finally (releases the HTTP handle), tolerates BrokenPipe when piped into head.

nodes.label: Python caller / notebook
nodes.description: Code that does `for patient in mmai.iter_patients(...)` and hands mmai.model_input(patient) to a model while keeping patient['y'] as the answer key (usage shown in the module docstring, L43-48).

nodes.label: tests/test_mmai.py
nodes.description: Network-free pytest suite (fake rows, monkeypatched iter_rows) covering grouping, stage parsing, build_patient shape, model_input leakage, flags, CLI JSONL, argument validation; one @network test streams the first patients from the Hub (run with -m network).

nodes.label: iter_patients()
nodes.description: Public entry point (L384-413). Checks arguments eagerly (so errors surface before any download), rejects with_summary without with_y, then returns the _iter_patients generator. Args: split, limit, sample, with_y, with_dates, with_summary, revision (pinned commit), batch_size.

nodes.label: _check_selection()
nodes.description: Validates split in (train,val,test), limit >= 0 and sample in (0,1]. Called by iter_patients and again by patients_from_rows.

nodes.label: _iter_patients() orchestrator
nodes.description: Generator (L416-443) that wires the stream together: picks the note columns (adds masked_text + note_is_from_positive_prompt when with_y), loads the small trial-label table if with_y, loads document dates if with_dates, opens the notes row stream, and `yield from` patients_from_rows. Returns immediately when limit == 0.

nodes.label: model_input()
nodes.description: Builds the object to hand a model (L323-334): opaque patient_id plus documents reduced to seq/type/date/text, dropping flagged documents (refusals/placeholders) unless include_flagged. No split, source, MRN or y. seq keeps original positions so a gap shows a dropped note.

nodes.label: iter_rows()
nodes.description: Streams one parquet file as dict rows (L90-105): opens datasets/<repo>@<revision>/<file> through HfFileSystem (32 MB blocks, cache_type='none'), pq.ParquetFile(buffer_size=32 MB, pre_buffer=False), iter_batches(batch_size, columns=...) and yields batch.to_pylist(). Only requested columns are fetched, so memory stays bounded (~0.5 GB RSS) even for a single huge row group.

nodes.label: load_trial_labels()
nodes.description: Reads the small eligibility table (pseudo_mrn, nct_id, title, this_space, eligibility_result; + patient_summary when with_summary, ~80 MB) into a dict keyed by pseudo_mrn. ~5-15 s without the summary.

nodes.label: load_document_dates()
nodes.description: Streams ~1 GB of patient_long_text from the summaries file (~3-4 min) and keeps only the '<date> <doc_type>' headers per patient via parse_document_dates (regex over DOC_TYPES). Dates exist nowhere else in the dataset.

nodes.label: HfFileSystem + pyarrow
nodes.description: fsspec file object over the Hub. pyarrow reads the parquet footer, then fetches only the needed column chunks with HTTP range requests; nothing is written to disk. The notes file has a single 7 GB row group and no page index, so reading is forward-only (no random access).

nodes.label: all_synthetic_notes.parquet
nodes.description: 846,577 synthetic notes for 63,865 patients (columns used: pseudo_mrn, event_type, synthetic_note, split, event_text, masked_text, note_is_from_positive_prompt). Sorted by pseudo_mrn, so each patient's notes are contiguous. 7 GB single row group.

nodes.label: space_specific_eligibility_checks.parquet
nodes.description: Small per-patient table: clinical-trial space, NCT id, title, LLM eligibility judgement, optional patient_summary.

nodes.label: patient_summaries_and_their_spaces.parquet
nodes.description: Holds patient_long_text: the dated, chunk-filtered concatenation of a patient's notes; the only source of synthetic YYYY-MM-DD dates.

nodes.label: patients_from_rows()
nodes.description: Network-free core (L346-376): validates selection, groups the row stream by pseudo_mrn, skips patients outside the requested split or hash-sample, calls build_patient with that patient's trial label and dates, counts emitted patients and stops at limit.

nodes.label: group_consecutive()
nodes.description: itertools.groupby wrapper that yields (key, list) per patient and raises ValueError if a key returns after its group ended, i.e. the input was not sorted. This is what turns an ordered row stream into per-patient groups with only one patient held in memory.

nodes.label: Sampling & opaque IDs
nodes.description: sample_bucket(mrn): deterministic [0,1) from sha256(repo:mrn) so sample=0.01 gives the same spread-out subset every time. opaque_patient_id(mrn): 'mmai-' + 12 hex chars, because raw pseudo_mrn < 1e6 is exactly the designed-eligible group and would leak the design label.

nodes.label: build_patient()
nodes.description: Assembles one patient object (L258-320) from that patient's note rows: checks one split, attaches dates only when the (date,type) headers line up 1:1 with note types (else None, ~4.5% of patients), builds documents[{seq,type,date,text,flag}], and when with_y builds y (event_history, diagnoses, document_events, trial, patient_summary).

nodes.label: strip_event_markers()
nodes.description: Turns masked_text (timeline with one event wrapped in <BEGIN/END EVENT ...> markers) into the plain timeline used as y.event_history.

nodes.label: parse_diagnoses() + parse_stage()
nodes.description: Finds timeline lines that state a cancer diagnosis (is_diagnosis_line: 'diagnos*' word with stage/ICD-O/TNM evidence, or ICD-O site+morphology) and regex-parses overall stage (Arabic -> Roman, sub-stage, refinement 'III (IIIb)') plus age_of(). A convenience parse, not a gold label.

nodes.label: document_flag()
nodes.description: Marks a generated note unusable: 'refusal' (empty or 'I'm sorry...' under 600 chars) or 'placeholder_event' (note generated from a bracketed or chatter event). Whole corpus at the pinned revision: 1 refusal, 2 placeholders. Flag is stored on the document; model_input drops flagged ones.

nodes.label: SLM / experiments (OncoLens-lab)
nodes.description: Downstream consumer of the JSON: prompts built from model_input; y.diagnoses / document_events used as answer sources for RECIST/stage extraction experiments. Lives in the sibling OncoLens-lab repo (not part of oncolens/).

flows.name: 1. Start a stream (validate first)
flows.description: From the call to a ready generator; bad arguments fail before any network traffic.

steps.details: iter_patients(split='test', sample=0.01, limit=20, with_dates=True)
Also rejects with_summary without with_y.
split in train/val/test, limit >= 0, 0 < sample <= 1; ValueError otherwise.
Nothing is downloaded until the first next(): the work starts lazily.

flows.name: 2. Load trial labels (small side table)
flows.description: If with_y: one quick pass over the eligibility file builds pseudo_mrn -> trial label.

steps.details: with_y=True so trial info goes into y.trial.
pseudo_mrn, nct_id, title, this_space, eligibility_result (+patient_summary).
512-row pyarrow batches, requested columns only.
Footer first, then column chunks over HTTP.
Few MB (~80 MB with the summary); ~5-15 s.

flows.name: 3. Stream notes into patients (core path)
flows.description: The main pipeline: forward-only read of the 7 GB notes file, grouped into one patient at a time.

steps.details: Columns: pseudo_mrn, event_type, synthetic_note, split, event_text (+masked_text, positive flag for y).
iter_batches -> to_pylist -> yield rows one by one.
32 MB blocks, no cache, no pre-buffer; no disk writes.
Sorted by pseudo_mrn: each patient's notes contiguous; first patient after ~10-20 s, ~1,000 notes/s.
Applies split/sample/limit filters while iterating.
Only the current patient's notes are held; raises if input is not grouped.
sample_bucket decides inclusion; opaque_patient_id names the patient.
documents + y; caller receives one JSON-serialisable dict per patient.
Memory stays ~0.5 GB regardless of how many patients are consumed.

flows.name: 4. Attach document dates (optional, ~3-4 min)
flows.description: with_dates streams patient_long_text first and keeps only the date/type headers.

steps.details: Dates are loaded before the first patient is emitted.
parse_document_dates regex on '<YYYY-MM-DD> <doc_type>' lines.
batch_size=256 for the large text column.
~1 GB of patient_long_text.
Only place dates exist.
document_dates.get(mrn) for each patient.
Dates attached only if (date,type) headers match note types 1:1; else every date is None (~4.5%).

flows.name: 5. Derive y (answers) from the timeline
flows.description: y is parsed from generator-side columns, never from the note text the model sees.

steps.details: Takes masked_text of the first note, trial label and positive-prompt flags.
Removes <BEGIN/END EVENT> markers -> y.event_history.
Diagnosis lines with parsed overall stage (Roman, sub-stage) -> y.diagnoses; document_events keeps each note's source event.

flows.name: 6. Flag unusable notes
flows.description: Refusals and placeholder-event notes are marked per document at assembly time.

steps.details: Calls document_flag(synthetic_note, event_text).
refusal / placeholder_event / None. Corpus-wide: 1 refusal, 2 placeholders.
model_input omits flagged docs unless include_flagged; seq gaps remain visible.

flows.name: 7. Build the model prompt (no leakage)
flows.description: What a model sees vs. what stays in y.

steps.details: Full patient dict incl. y, split, source.
patient_id + documents[seq,type,date,text]; no MRN, split, source, y.
Prompt JSON for the extraction model; y used only for scoring.
parser.error on bad combos (--summary with --no-y, limit <= 0).
Same API as Python callers; ValueError becomes a CLI error.
Lazily reads from the Hub.
split / sample / limit.
With y unless --no-y / --model-input.
--model-input writes only the prompt-safe object.
One JSON object per line; closed in finally, BrokenPipe tolerated.

flows.name: 9. Choose a subset (split / sample / limit)
flows.description: Splits and samples are filters on a forward scan, not random access.

steps.details: split, sample, limit.
Range checks.
Skips patients of other splits; stops after limit.
Filtering happens per patient group.
sample=0.01 keeps ~1% spread over the file; limit alone gives a narrow all-eligible slice (file is grouped by trial space/design).
